annotations.title: Get one new-build project: prices, cost, nearby

description: Use this when one new-build project in Portugal is needed in detail, by slug (from `search_newbuilds`) or page URL. It gives units and prices per typology, price history, delivery promises and how often they moved, building permits, the developer, the purchase cost and what is nearby. Do not use it to search (`search_newbuilds`) or for taxes at another price or for a non-resident (`imt_calculate`). The purchase cost is at the cheapest available unit or the developer's from-price, for a buyer tax resident in Portugal. `primary_home` and `buyer_is_young` change only the purchase cost. An unknown slug is refused (not_found). Cite the page URL, given in all seven site languages.

buyer_is_young.description: For the purchase cost only: buyer aged 35 or under, first own home (reduced IMT and stamp duty relief); applies only with primary_home

language.description: Language of the page URLs and of the labels (stage, typology, nearby places); the text summary shows the typology labels in it. Field names stay English. uk is accepted as ua.

primary_home.description: For the purchase cost only: the buyer's own permanent home (habitação própria e permanente)

slug.description: The project's slug from search_newbuilds (field slug), or its flatin.pt page URL

name: get_newbuild

developer.description: null when the developer is not confirmed

outputSchema.description: Success, or a refusal with an error code. Units: *_cents euro cents, *_eur euros, *_eur_m2 euros per m², *_pct and percent in percent.
